title: Payment Provider Event Admission Boundary
admissionRules: Signature verification MUST complete before any internal subscription or entitlement mutation.
The provider callback MUST NOT directly assert subscription ACTIVE, entitlement ACTIVE or ledger finality.
Duplicate providerEventId is an idempotent replay and MUST NOT create a second lifecycle transition.
Unknown provider event types are rejected and retained for reconciliation; they do not fail open.
Out-of-order provider events are applied only when the Commerce/Payment ordering rule proves they are newer than the authoritative payment outcome.
Refund, chargeback and reversal events MUST be able to initiate entitlement convergence.
Financial facts remain in D1-04/Ledger; access-state effects cross into D1-01 through an approved W07→W02 transition.
No provider-specific payload fields are exposed directly as public LuckRead API DTO fields.

runtimeBoundary.persistenceOwner: W07/D1-04 for payment facts; W02/D1-01 for access state

evidenceRequired: payment success to subscription activation evidence
